newsitem.title: USA: Ohio 1,205 MW Perry nuke seen at full power Monday.
newsitem.headline: Ohio 1,205 MW Perry nuke seen at full power Monday.

text.p: The 1,205 megawatt Perry nuclear power plant in North Perry, Ohio, will likely reach full electricity output Monday following a repair outage, a spokesman for the plant's operator said.
"We're now at about 92 percent (of capacity), and we expect to be back at 100 percent by mid-afternoon," Jim Sielicki, spokesman for plant operator Centerior Energy Corp said Monday.
The plant was shut Tuesday to correct an electrical problem linked to the system that monitors feedwater levels.
Centerior is the majority owner of the plant, while Ohio Edison Co and DQE Inc also have interests in the plant.
